market_outlook.short_term: Markets face tug-of-war: equity rally (Dow +500) vs. 90% rate-hike odds and $108 oil. Expect volatility in 10Y yields (currently multiyear highs). Oil supply disruptions from Saudi/Iran corridor dominate. CPI-driven Fed hawkishness caps upside for rate-sensitive sectors. 2-3% downside risk if oil breaches $115.
market_outlook.long_term: Higher-for-longer rates become structural, compressing equity multiples 5-10%. AI capex cycle continues but governance/regulatory risk adds premium. Energy transition (Oman hydrogen, Europe solar storage) creates 5-year investment themes. Geopolitical fragmentation (BRICS, Modi-Xi) reshapes trade flows. Consumer value shift persists through 2027.
